assumptions: U is steady-state unavailability (probability down) under stated conditions; year is the 8760-hour accounting year.
Linear accumulation: expected downtime scales with the window; no seasonality or planned-outage shaping.

constants.locator: Reference windows derived from EventHelix yearly downtime column (percent-to-annual-time pairing); 365*24 arithmetic in translation notes.

Minute/day renderings (52 min/yr, 3.65 days/yr) are display conversions of this record, not separate models.

models.inverse_notes: U = D/H needs D and H != 0; H = D/U needs D and U != 0. Check: D=87.6,H=8760 gives U=0.01. D above H maps back against the U <= 1 guard. Algebraic only.
limitations: Expected (average-year) downtime, not a prediction for any specific year or system.
Planned maintenance shaping and nonstationary failure intensity need separate records.

references.method: EventHelix tables: 99% availability pairs with 3.65 days/year = 87.6 h; 0.01*8760 = 87.6 exactly.
references.provenance: Published table value reproduced through the record (EventHelix).

references.method: EventHelix parallel table: three 99% legs give 99.9999% with 31 seconds/year; 1e-6*8760 h = 0.00876 h = 31.5 s, source displays rounded 31 s.
references.provenance: Published table value reproduced through the record (EventHelix); tolerance covers display rounding.

references.method: Boundary: zero unavailability gives zero annual downtime; admitted ideal boundary.

rejection_cases.reason: Unavailability above 1 violates the probability guard U <= 1.
Unavailability U is required; empty input leaves D undetermined.

relationship.locator: EventHelix series/parallel/worked-example tables pairing each availability level with its yearly downtime (99% <-> 3.65 days/yr; 99.99% <-> 52 min/yr; 99.9999% <-> 31 s/yr; 99.998% <-> 10.51 min/yr).
relationship.translation_notes: Source tabulates the pairing without printing the equation; formalized as linear scaling U*H with the hours H in the reference year stated as an explicit input (reference case H=8760 h = 365*24, pure arithmetic in notes). Locals U, H; output D. Check: dimensionless x time = time.

sources.evidence: Availability/downtime tables pair 99% with 3.65 days/year, 99.99% with 52 minutes/year, 99.9999% (three parallel 99% legs) with 31 seconds/year, and worked-example rows (99.998% with 10.51 minutes/year).
